apiVersion: widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1

metadata:
  annotations:
    krateo.io/allowed-resources: derived
    krateo.io/nav-label: Pod sizing
    krateo.io/nav-order: '100'
    krateo.io/nav-path: /pod-sizing-demo
  name: page-pod-sizing-demo
  namespace: '{{ include "page.tierNamespace" (dict "ctx" . "tier" "common") }}'
spec:
  resourcesRefs:
    items:
      - apiVersion: widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1
        id: page-pod-sizing-demo-row
        name: page-pod-sizing-demo-row
        namespace: krateo-system
        resource: rows
        verb: GET
      - apiVersion: widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1
        id: page-pod-sizing-demo-header
        name: page-pod-sizing-demo-header
        namespace: '{{ include "page.tierNamespace" (dict "ctx" . "tier" "common") }}'
        resource: pageheaders
        verb: GET
  widgetData:
    allowedResources:
      - rows
      - pageheaders
    gap: middle
    items:
      - resourceRefId: page-pod-sizing-demo-row
      - resourceRefId: page-pod-sizing-demo-header
    vertical: true

apiVersion: widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1
kind: PageHeader
metadata:
  name: page-pod-sizing-demo-header
  namespace: '{{ include "page.tierNamespace" (dict "ctx" . "tier" "common") }}'
spec:
  resourcesRefs:
    items: []
  widgetData:
    title: Pod sizing

apiVersion: v2
appVersion: CHART_VERSION
description: Krateo Composable Portal pages — pod-sizing-demo.
name: pod-sizing-demo
type: application
version: CHART_VERSION

tiers:
  # Namespace this page set is created in. Empty = the release namespace.
  common: ""

apiVersion: widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1
kind: Row
metadata:
  annotations:
    krateo.io/allowed-resources: derived
  name: page-pod-sizing-demo-row
  namespace: krateo-system
spec:
  resourcesRefs:
    items:
      - apiVersion: widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1
        id: pod-sizing-demo-table
        name: pod-sizing-demo-table
        namespace: krateo-system
        resource: tables
        verb: GET
  widgetData:
    allowedResources:
      - tables
    items:
      - resourceRefId: pod-sizing-demo-table

apiVersion: widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1
kind: Table
metadata:
  name: pod-sizing-demo-table
  namespace: krateo-system
spec:
  widgetDataTemplate:
  - expression: ${ .items }
    forPath: dataSource
  apiRef:
    name: pod-sizing-demo-query
    namespace: krateo-system
  resourcesRefs:
    items: []
  widgetData:
    allowedResources: []
    columns:
      - title: Pod
        valueKey: pod
      - title: Requested
        valueKey: requested
      - title: Used
        valueKey: used
      - title: Utilization
        valueKey: utilization
      - title: Verdict
        valueKey: verdict

apiVersion: templates.krateo.io/v1
kind: RESTAction
metadata:
  name: pod-sizing-demo-query
  namespace: krateo-system
spec:
  api:
    - headers:
        - 'Accept: application/json'
      name: pods
      path: /api/v1/namespaces/krateo-system/pods
      verb: GET
    - headers:
        - 'Accept: application/json'
      name: metrics
      path: /apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/krateo-system/pods
      verb: GET
  filter: |-
    include "quantity";
    . as $r
    | { items: [
          $r.pods.items[] as $p
          | ([ $r.metrics.items[] | select(.metadata.name == $p.metadata.name) ] | first) as $m
          | ([ $p.spec.containers[].resources.requests.cpu // empty ] | sum_quantities) as $req
          | ([ (($m.containers // [])[]).usage.cpu ] | sum_quantities) as $use
          | utilization_pct($use; $req) as $pct
          | provisioning_verdict($pct) as $v
          # ORDERED FOR THE QUESTION BEING ASKED, which is not the module's default order.
          # provisioning_severity ranks Underprovisioned above Overprovisioned, and it is right to:
          # throttling a workload now is worse than paying for capacity nobody uses. But this page asks
          # "what is oversized", and under that ranking the first sixteen rows were all
          # Underprovisioned — so on a virtualized table showing thirteen, the word Overprovisioned
          # never appeared at all. The subject of the page has to be on the first screen.
          # Within each group the WORST case leads: the emptiest reservation for the overprovisioned,
          # the most throttled for the underprovisioned.
          | ({ "Overprovisioned": 3, "Underprovisioned": 2, "Unknown": 1, "Right-sized": 0 }[$v]) as $grp
          | (if $v == "Overprovisioned" then -($pct // 0) else ($pct // -1) end) as $worst
          | { rank: [ $grp, $worst ],
              row: [
                { kind: "jsonSchemaType", type: "string", valueKey: "pod",
                  stringValue: $p.metadata.name },
                { kind: "jsonSchemaType", type: "string", valueKey: "requested",
                  stringValue: (if $req == null then "—" else (($req*1000|round|tostring) + "m") end) },
                { kind: "jsonSchemaType", type: "string", valueKey: "used",
                  stringValue: (if $use == null then "—" else (($use*1000|round|tostring) + "m") end) },
                { kind: "jsonSchemaType", type: "string", valueKey: "utilization",
                  stringValue: (if $pct == null then "—" else (($pct|tostring) + "%") end) },
                { kind: "tag", valueKey: "verdict", stringValue: $v,
                  color: ({ "Underprovisioned": "red", "Overprovisioned": "gold",
                            "Right-sized": "green", "Unknown": "default" }[$v]) }
              ] }
        ]
        | sort_by(.rank) | reverse | map(.row) }

# REGISTERS this page set as installable. Apply the STAMPED copy from the GitHub release, not this
# one: the branch carries the CHART_VERSION placeholder, and registering that pins a chart version
# that was never published.
#
#   kubectl apply -f https://github.com/krateo-blueprints/pod-sizing-demo/releases/download/<tag>/compositiondefinition.yaml
#
# Install it WHERE THE PORTAL IS — the pages must land in namespaces the portal's RBAC covers.
apiVersion: core.krateo.io/v1alpha1
kind: CompositionDefinition
metadata:
  name: pod-sizing-demo
  namespace: krateo-system
spec:
  chart:
    url: oci://ghcr.io/krateo-blueprints/charts/pod-sizing-demo
    version: CHART_VERSION
